capabilities: Parse time.md exports in JSON, CSV, YAML, and Markdown formats
Render Overview, Trends, Calendar, Details, Apps & Categories, Projects, Web History, Reports, and Input Tracking views
Embed live widgets in notes via timemd code blocks with configurable parameters
Visualize input-tracking data such as cursor heatmaps, typing intensity, and top typed words
Export reports as CSV, JSON, or Markdown
disambiguation: Not a time tracker itself; it only renders data exported from the separate time.md app.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README describes it as pre-release with manual installation only (build locally and copy files into the plugins folder).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open or visualize screen-time analytics exports, forcing users to leave their vault and open the time.md app to inspect their data.

relations.evidence: navigates and visualizes data exported from the time.md screen-time analytics app

summary: Dashboard and visualization plugin that parses exports from the time.md screen-time analytics app and renders usage charts, heatmaps, and embeddable widgets in notes.
